items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: It was a Charles DeVerny or something, played trombone or something.

ctx.x: Oh, there was a woman who played piano for the rubber show, Ms. Margaret or something. Oh yeah, Margaret. Devoiney. Oh good, we got her name, you mentioned her before. Yeah, Devoiney. Couldn't think of her last name. Big family then, Devoiney's. Several of them played music, didn't they? Yeah, family then.
I believe Ernest Rappanian's wife was a Devoiney. Oh, really? Yeah. It was a Charles DeVerny or something, played trombone or something.
She's what? I think it was a Charles DeVerny played trombone or something. Yeah, it's a big family.
